study_identification.title: A multimodal neural signature of face processing in autism within the fusiform gyrus

study_characteristics.study_objective: Integrate individual-level deviations across sMRI, rs-fMRI, task-fMRI, and EEG within fusiform gyrus using normative modeling and LICA to test whether multimodal components differentiate autistic vs nonautistic individuals and relate to social functioning.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Two-sample t-tests on extreme deviations (|Z|>2.6) between ASD and NAI; SVM (linear kernel) classification comparing unimodal vs multimodal IC features under 10-fold CV with permutation testing of AUC differences; CCA linking multimodal ICs to social (significant) vs nonsocial (non-significant; r=0.45, pFDR=0.64) features with permutation inference.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: A single multimodal component within fusiform gyrus significantly differentiates ASD from NAI, multimodal features outperform unimodal ones, and multimodal expression relates to social—but not nonsocial—functioning.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Among ICs, a multimodal component (IC44) showed higher loadings in ASD than NAI (t=3.5, pFDR=0.027), driven mainly by rs-fMRI (R 48.5%, L 35.0%), with smaller contributions from EEG L (11.6%), task-fMRI R (3.3%) and structure (R 1.0%, L 0.5%). Multimodal components outperformed unimodal ones in SVM classification. CCA showed significant associations with social-communicative features, but not with nonsocial features (r=0.45, pFDR=0.64).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: ROI restricted to fusiform gyrus (regional focus); no external/different-domain validation; EEG spatial resolution reduced via parcellation; cross-sectional design limits causal inference.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Normative modeling per modality (PCNtoolkit v0.26) combined via LICA; multimodality quantified via MMI threshold with components defined as multimodal when no single modality >90% and MMI<0.1; robustness tested across thresholds and matched feature counts; rigorous modality-specific QC and harmonized ROI coverage.

general_notes.general_notes: Six acquisition sites; site included as covariate; age modeled nonlinearly via B-splines (primary) with linear-age sensitivity; ROI coverage standardized across modalities; external code link provided; forward models visualized at FFA peak (MRI) and 170 ms (EEG).
